name: 은백·금색 대검 기사
processing: Immutable approved sword pixels selected once. Bodies drawn with no weapon. The same sword is composited using only uniform scale, rigid rotation and translation, with body glove pixels in foreground. Transparent registration padding and lossless WebP packing. No still transforms counted as drawn body frames.
